heading: Bengaluru rent leaves woman shocked, ₹60,000 for 2BHK with ₹3-8 lakh deposit: ‘You might find God, but house not sure…’
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: A woman shared that she struggled to find a house in Bengaluru despite living there for past few years as landlords charge high rental fee with additional maintenance and deposit. She alleged that nobody questions why rent prices are so high in Bengaluru.
